Identified as this saint because: Found by reading the Commons category off Wikidata — Q2272032, «Herman of Kazan and Svyazhsk», a Russian bishop and saint — which gives `Category:German of Kazan`. The file's title names the folder's own man and his own office together: «Митрополит Афанасий посвящает Германа в архиепископы Казанские», Metropolitan Athanasius consecrating Herman archbishop of Kazan, which is this folder's `hierarch` and `archbishop` and its Russian form «Герман Казанский». A plate of the Lives, so it is a scene rather than a portrait icon, and the hero will show the consecration; it is taken over the day-matched plate in the same category because the title names him in full rather than as a bare «Герман». 849x1545. Commons describes it: Metropolitan Athanasius consecrates Herman as Archbishop of Kazan
